from AlgorithmImports import *


class IndependentSlotsAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    def initialize(self):
        self.set_start_date(2006, 1, 3)
        self.set_end_date(2015, 12, 31)
        self.set_cash(1_000_000)

        self.spy = self.add_equity("SPY", Resolution.DAILY).symbol
        self.aapl = self.add_equity("AAPL", Resolution.DAILY).symbol
        self.ibm = self.add_equity("IBM", Resolution.DAILY).symbol
        self.bac = self.add_equity("BAC", Resolution.DAILY).symbol
        self.aig = self.add_equity("AIG", Resolution.DAILY).symbol
        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_sma = self.sma(self.spy, 100, Resolution.DAILY)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.rsi(
            self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.WILDERS, Resolution.DAILY
        )

        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
        self.strategy_b_shares = 0

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None
        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.set_warm_up(100, Resolution.DAILY)

    def on_data(self, data: Slice):
        complete_day = all(data.bars.contains_key(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols)

        if complete_day and self._rules_ready():
            spy_close = data.bars[self.spy].close
            aapl_close = data.bars[self.aapl].close

            # Sells are evaluated before buys.
            if (
                self.strategy_a_shares > 0
                and self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
                and spy_close < self.spy_sma.current.value
            ):
                self.market_order(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_shares)
                self.strategy_a_shares = 0

            if self.strategy_b_shares > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.current.value > 60:
                self.market_order(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_shares)
                self.strategy_b_shares = 0

            if (
                self.strategy_a_shares == 0
                and self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
                and spy_close > self.spy_sma.current.value
            ):
                shares = int((self.portfolio.total_portfolio_value * 0.40) // spy_close)
                if shares > 0:
                    self.market_order(self.spy, shares)
                    self.strategy_a_shares = shares

            if (
                self.strategy_b_shares == 0
                and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3
                and self.portfolio.cash >= 20_000
            ):
                shares = int(20_000 // aapl_close)
                if shares > 0:
                    self.market_order(self.aapl, shares)
                    self.strategy_b_shares = shares

        if data.bars.contains_key(self.spy):
            self.previous_spy_close = data.bars[self.spy].close
            self.previous_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.current.value

        if data.bars.contains_key(self.aapl):
            aapl_close = data.bars[self.aapl].close
            if self.previous_aapl_close is None:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0
            elif aapl_close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0
            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_close

    def _rules_ready(self):
        return (
            not self.is_warming_up
            and self.spy_sma.is_ready
            and self.aapl_rsi.is_ready
            and self.previous_spy_close is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
            and self.previous_aapl_close is not None
        )

class PrivateLotStrategyAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(100)
        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14, MovingAverageType.Wilders)

        self.previous_close = {symbol: None for symbol in self.symbols}
        self.previous_spy_sma = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        spy_sma_yesterday = self.spy_sma.Current.Value if self.spy_sma.IsReady else None

        for symbol in self.symbols:
            if data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol):
                bar = data.Bars[symbol]

                if symbol == self.spy:
                    self.spy_sma.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)

                if symbol == self.aapl:
                    prior_close = self.previous_close[symbol]
                    if prior_close is not None and bar.Close < prior_close:
                        self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                    else:
                        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

                    self.aapl_rsi.Update(bar.EndTime, bar.Close)

                self.previous_close[symbol] = bar.Close

        if not all(data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols):
            return

        if not self.spy_sma.IsReady or not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
            self.previous_spy_sma = spy_sma_yesterday
            return

        spy_close_today = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
        spy_close_yesterday = self.previous_close[self.spy]
        aapl_close_today = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close

        # Restore SPY's prior close for cross evaluation, since it was updated above.
        # It is available from the bar history through the SMA update sequence.
        if self.spy_sma.Samples > 1:
            spy_close_yesterday = self.spy_sma.Window[1].Value

        sma_today = self.spy_sma.Current.Value
        sma_yesterday = spy_sma_yesterday

        spy_crosses_above = (
            sma_yesterday is not None
            and spy_close_yesterday <= sma_yesterday
            and spy_close_today > sma_today
        )
        spy_crosses_below = (
            sma_yesterday is not None
            and spy_close_yesterday >= sma_yesterday
            and spy_close_today < sma_today
        )

        # Sells before buys.
        if self.strategy_a_lot > 0 and spy_crosses_below:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
            self.strategy_a_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
            self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_a_lot == 0 and spy_crosses_above:
            shares = int((self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * 0.40) / spy_close_today)
            if shares > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, shares)
                self.strategy_a_lot = shares

        if self.strategy_b_lot == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
            if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20000:
                shares = int(20000 / aapl_close_today)
                if shares > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, shares)
                    self.strategy_b_lot = shares

        self.previous_spy_sma = sma_yesterday

from AlgorithmImports import *
from collections import deque
import math


class IndependentSlotsStrategy(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_closes = deque(maxlen=101)
        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0
        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14, MovingAverageType.Wilders)

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

    def OnData(self, data):
        spy_bar = data.Bars.get(self.spy)
        aapl_bar = data.Bars.get(self.aapl)

        # Market-state quantities continue updating whenever their own bars exist.
        if spy_bar is not None:
            self.spy_closes.append(float(spy_bar.Close))

        if aapl_bar is not None:
            aapl_close = float(aapl_bar.Close)
            if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:
                if aapl_close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0
            self.aapl_rsi.Update(aapl_bar.EndTime, aapl_close)
            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_close

        # Skip all rule evaluation unless every subscribed ticker has today's bar.
        if any(symbol not in data.Bars for symbol in self.symbols):
            return

        # Sells are evaluated before buys.
        if self.strategy_a_lot > 0 and len(self.spy_closes) == 101:
            closes = list(self.spy_closes)
            yesterday_sma = sum(closes[:100]) / 100.0
            today_sma = sum(closes[1:]) / 100.0

            if closes[-2] >= yesterday_sma and closes[-1] < today_sma:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
                self.strategy_a_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
            if float(self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value) > 60:
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
                self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_a_lot == 0 and len(self.spy_closes) == 101:
            closes = list(self.spy_closes)

class ParallelPrivateLotsAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_sma = self.SMA(self.spy, 100, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.Wilders, Resolution.Daily)

        self.spy_closes = RollingWindow[float](2)

        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.spy):
            self.spy_closes.Add(float(data.Bars[self.spy].Close))

        if data.Bars.ContainsKey(self.aapl):
            aapl_close = float(data.Bars[self.aapl].Close)

            if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:
                if aapl_close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_close

        if any(not data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols):
            return

        if (not self.spy_sma.IsReady or
                self.spy_sma.Window.Count < 2 or
                self.spy_closes.Count < 2 or
                not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady):
            return

        spy_close = float(data.Bars[self.spy].Close)
        aapl_close = float(data.Bars[self.aapl].Close)

        today_sma = float(self.spy_sma.Current.Value)
        yesterday_sma = float(self.spy_sma.Window[1].Value)
        yesterday_spy_close = self.spy_closes[1]

        # Sells are evaluated before buys.
        if self.strategy_a_lot > 0 and \
                yesterday_spy_close >= yesterday_sma and spy_close < today_sma:
            self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
            self.strategy_a_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and float(self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value) > 60:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
            self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_a_lot == 0 and \
                yesterday_spy_close <= yesterday_sma and spy_close > today_sma:
            shares = int((0.40 * float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue)) / spy_close)
            if shares > 0:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, shares)
                self.strategy_a_lot = shares

        if self.strategy_b_lot == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
            if float(self.Portfolio.Cash) >= 20000:
                shares = int(20000 / aapl_close)
                if shares > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, shares)
                    self.strategy_b_lot = shares
